evidence_checked: jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12458.txt, EO_12639.txt, EO_12680.txt, EO_12738.txt, EO_13091.txt, EO_13118.txt, EO_13361.txt (section 1-301 amendments)
jobs/current-law/output/MENTIONS.csv and EVENT_CANDIDATES.csv rows for EO:12423
reasons: The genuine claim differs from the planted control in one field only: operative_clauses[EO:12423#sec2].first_end.date is 2013-03-08. That date matches EO 13637 of March 8, 2013 (78 FR 16129, published 2013-03-13), whose section 4 revokes EO 11958 as amended. It also matches the clause's judgment reason and the research rationale. Identity checks: EO 12423 of May 26, 1983, Foreign Assistance and Arms Control, 48 FR 24025, FR Doc. 83-14689. All quoted spans (EO 12423, EO 13637 section 4, EO 12560 section 11) re-hash and match the held bytes, and the two-section inventory is complete. EO 12560 section 11 (1986-05-24) restated section 1(d) of EO 11958 'to read as follows'. The claim records that restatement as a later event with the reviewer note that the substance changed, which is what the owner's strike-and-insert ruling of 2026-10-21 requires. No earlier end for section 2 is shown. EO 13637 section 1(d) re-delegates sections 22(a), 29, 30 and 30A to the Secretary of Defense, and its section 4 saves actions taken under EO 11958, so the savings state transferred_or_accrued is supported. For section 1, I read the held texts of the later amenders of section 1-301 of EO 12163: EO 12458 section 2, EO 12560 sections 7 and 8, EO 12639 section 6, EO 12680 section 4, EO 12738 section 5, EO 13091 section 3, and EO 13118 and EO 13361. Each changes other subsections; none rewrites 1-301(b). EO 12163 is still printed as current under 22 U.S.C. 2381, and EO 13637 does not name it. Section 1 is therefore operative on 2026-10-14, and the order's YES status is supported.
